name: Admin 2FA fails with all invalid TOTP codes (consolidated)
fullName: ../.features-gen/e2e-tests/bdd/features/login-errors.feature.spec.js › Authentication Error Handling › Admin 2FA fails with all invalid TOTP codes (consolidated)

steps.name: Given real ADMIN credentials are available
When the ADMIN user signs in through the sign-in form
Then a two-factor challenge should be presented
2FA verify dialog must open for an admin with TOTP configured
When the admin submits an invalid TOTP code "000000"
Then the two-factor verification is rejected with "error.auth.2fa_invalid_code"
